newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarb-C to vote on merger March 24.
newsitem.headline: Polifarb-C to vote on merger March 24.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish paintmaker Polifarb Cieszyn SA will vote on March 24 on a planned merger with Polifarb Wroclaw, Polifarb Cieszyn said in a statement on Thursday.
The company said its shareholders would vote on all necessary motions to merge with Wroclaw by taking over all assets of Wroclaw.
It said its shareholders would vote on a new scrip issue for current Cieszyn's shareholders to match the number of Wroclaw's shares and on another rights share issue. It gave no further details.

Earlier Cieszyn said that under the plan it would raise its share capital by 2,978,820 shares to equal Wroclaw's 22,103,820 shares and set another issue for Wroclaw shareholders to facilitate a one-for-one share exchange to effect the merger.
The new entity, due to start operation in the second half of 1997 is expected to have about 40 percent of the market.
